GraphQL reference

This page is generated from the staff view’s schema, the whole audience graph as staffql serves it. Fields and types marked staffql only aren’t in the consumer view, the graphql endpoint the apps call (see GraphQL). Download the dumps: consumer (introspection), staff (introspection).

Audience

Section titled “Audience”
Field Type Description
activity staffql only
after: String
before: String
first: Int
last: Int
userId: ID		 AudienceActivityConnection! The audience’s activity log, newest first. Admins only.
appReview AudienceAppReview! App Review settings: period end time and reusable review code.
chat IAudienceChat! The instance’s IAudienceChat mixin. Left out of the schema where its module isn’t installed.
closestLocale
near: CoordinatesInput!		 Locale The locale nearest a position.
domains [AudienceDomain!]! Domains connected to this audience. They change on /v1/tenants/graphql only.
events IAudienceEvents! The instance’s IAudienceEvents mixin. Left out of the schema where its module isn’t installed.
extensionMixins [ExtensionMixin!]! Declared mixins and viewer access gates.
extensions
after: String
before: String
first: Int
last: Int		 ExtensionConnection! Capabilities available to this audience. Configured remotes are excluded.
facebook IAudienceFacebook! The instance’s IAudienceFacebook mixin. Left out of the schema where its module isn’t installed.
fieldEndpoints [FieldEndpoint!]! Every field in this endpoint’s schema that declares the endpoints it is on (its @endpoint, which introspection does not carry).
fieldPermissions [FieldPermission!]! Every field in this endpoint’s schema that requires a permission, with the permissions (its @requires, which introspection does not carry).
id ID! Unique identifier.
inviteUrl String The link venue and talent Page managers open to join. Admins only; null for everyone else.
karaoke IAudienceKaraoke! The instance’s IAudienceKaraoke mixin. Left out of the schema where its module isn’t installed.
locale
id: ID!		 Locale A locale in the audience by its UUID.
locales [Locale!]! Locales belonging to this audience.
maintenance staffql only Maintenance! Maintenance operations and their runs. Admins only.
map
localeId: ID		 JSON! Its locale envelopes and venue envelopes and points, as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Admins only; empty for everyone else.
me UserState The signed-in viewer and their state here: their profile (self), what they block, the listings they manage and the modules’ viewer state. Null when nobody is signed in.
member staffql only
userId: ID!		 AudienceMember Someone who has signed in on the audience, by their user ID. Admins only.
members
after: String
before: String
first: Int
last: Int
search: String		 AudienceMemberConnection! People who have signed in on the audience’s console or apps, with their latest activity and whether they’re banned, oldest member first. Admins only; empty for everyone else.
name String! Display name.
node
id: ID!		 Node Fetches a record by its id, the UUID every Node carries; null when nothing visible to this request has it.
nodes
ids: [ID!]!		 [Node]! Fetches records by their ids, in the order asked; a missing one is null.
payments IAudiencePayments The instance’s IAudiencePayments mixin, when available to the viewer.
people IAudiencePeople! The instance’s IAudiencePeople mixin. Left out of the schema where its module isn’t installed.
photography IPhotography The instance’s IPhotography mixin, when available to the viewer.
ping IAudiencePing The instance’s IAudiencePing mixin, when available.
places staffql only IAudiencePlaces! The instance’s IAudiencePlaces mixin. Left out of the schema where its module isn’t installed.
posts IAudiencePosts! The instance’s IAudiencePosts mixin. Left out of the schema where its module isn’t installed.
push IAudiencePush The instance’s IAudiencePush mixin, when available to the viewer.
reports staffql only
after: String
before: String
first: Int
last: Int
open: Boolean		 ContentReportConnection! The audience’s report queue: what members reported (messages, people, venues, pings, photos) and whom they blocked, newest first. Admins only; empty for everyone else. Platform admins see every audience’s on the tenants endpoint (contentReports).
signInMethods [SignInMethod!]! How people can sign in to its apps and website. Its admin consoles and the staff apps always sign in as before.
signInWarnings [SignInWarning!]! What its apps and website say before each sign-in method that has a warning, with Cancel and Continue.
subdomain String! The unique audience subdomain.
tags
facets: Boolean
tribes: Boolean		 [Tag!]! Its tags for people, events and venues, by name.
theme AudienceTheme! The audience’s look: preset, tagline and colors.
ticketing IAudienceTicketing! The instance’s IAudienceTicketing mixin. Left out of the schema where its module isn’t installed.
tipping IAudienceTipping! The instance’s IAudienceTipping mixin. Left out of the schema where its module isn’t installed.
users staffql only
after: String
before: String
first: Int
last: Int
search: String		 UserConnection! Users across all audiences, for granting access or making admins. Super admins only.
venues IAudienceVenues! The instance’s IAudienceVenues mixin. Left out of the schema where its module isn’t installed.
webUrl String! Where the audience’s web app lives (https://hotmess.social): its first verified domain, else its console’s. Share links are /venues/<id>, /events/<id> and /people/<id> under it, which its app opens when installed.

Mutation

Section titled “Mutation”
Field Type Description
acceptTerms
input: TermsAcceptInput!		 TermsAcceptPayload Records that the signed-in user agreed to the terms of use, which forbid objectionable content and abuse. The apps ask before anyone chats.
addAppReviewCode staffql only
input: AppReviewCodeAddInput!		 AppReviewCodeAddPayload Adds an App Review code that signs in to Hot Mess as its own test account (AppReviewCode), created if need be. Platform administrators only.
addPhotographer staffql only
input: PhotographerAddInput!		 PhotographerAddPayload Grants a photographer’s hedonism_bot account access to the audience: their photos may be shown here, credited to them, in the metros chosen. Photos themselves arrive by pull over the photography provider contract (connectPhotographer), so no token is issued.
addVenueBannerPhoto staffql only
input: VenueBannerPhotoAddInput!		 VenueBannerPhotoAddPayload Adds an image to the end of a venue’s banner images: uploaded, or one of its photographers’ photos.
advanceLineup staffql only
input: LineupAdvanceInput!		 LineupAdvancePayload Advances a lineup like a slide deck: takes off what’s on stage and puts on what’s up next, posting “On now” to chat. With back, undoes the last advance. Without an event, advances the lineup on tonight (the venue’s own or an event’s: see IVenuePeople.onStage).
banAudienceMember staffql only
input: AudienceMemberBanInput!		 AudienceMemberBanPayload Kicks a member and keeps them out: they can’t sign in on the audience or chat in its venues until unbanned.
blockUser
input: BlockedUserAddInput!		 BlockedUserAddPayload Blocks someone: neither sees the other’s chat messages, presence, pings or whereabouts any more. They aren’t told. The audience’s admins are, in the console’s Reports queue.
buyCoatCheck
input: CoatCheckBuyInput!		 CoatCheckBuyPayload Starts paying coat check at a venue tonight through the venue’s payment provider. Asking again the same night returns the same pending or paid coat check pass.
buyCover
input: CoverBuyInput!		 CoverBuyPayload Starts paying tonight’s cover at a venue, through the venue’s provider. Stripe: finish the payment with Stripe’s payment sheet (paymentIntentClientSecret, on the venue’s account stripeAccountId, with publishableKey), then call confirmCover. Square: make a payment token with Square’s In-App Payments SDK (squareApplicationId, squareLocationId), then call payCover with it. Asking again the same night returns the same pass.
cancelRsvp
input: RSVPCancelInput!		 RSVPCancelPayload Takes back the user’s RSVP to an event, as if they’d never answered (UNSURE). Someone holding a ticket to it is still going: refund the ticket to stop going.
chat staffql only IMutationChat The instance’s IMutationChat mixin, when available to the viewer.
clearChatRoom staffql only
input: ChatRoomClearInput!		 ChatRoomClearPayload Clears a venue’s or a locale’s chat room: every message in it is removed, for everyone in the room and from the transcript.
clearCoverNight staffql only
input: CoverNightClearInput!		 CoverNightClearPayload Puts a night back to the usual cover at a venue whose door the caller works.
confirmCover
input: CoverConfirmInput!		 CoverConfirmPayload Checks a cover payment with its provider after the app finishes paying, so the pass works before the webhook arrives.
confirmTip
input: TipConfirmInput!		 TipConfirmPayload Checks a tip payment with its provider after the app finishes paying, before the webhook arrives.
connectEventbrite staffql only
input: EventbriteConnectInput!		 EventbriteConnectPayload Starts connecting an organizer’s Eventbrite account. Send the organizer to authorizeUrl; after they approve, Eventbrite returns them to returnTo with eventbrite=connected (or denied, or error) and their upcoming events are imported.
connectPersonSquare staffql only
input: PersonSquareConnectInput!		 PersonSquareConnectPayload Starts connecting a performer’s own Square account so fans can tip them in the apps. Send them to authorizeUrl; Square brings them back to returnTo with square=connected, pick_location (pick one with setPersonSquareLocation), declined or error.
connectPersonStripe staffql only
input: PersonStripeConnectInput!		 PersonStripeConnectPayload Starts connecting a performer’s own Stripe account so fans can tip them in the apps. Send them to onboardingUrl; Stripe brings them back to returnTo with stripe=connected (or pending, or error).
connectVenueKaraoke staffql only
input: VenueKaraokeConnectInput!		 VenueKaraokeConnectPayload Connects a venue to its karaoke partner, or changes the connection: its standing session code and, for partners with an API, its API token, stored encrypted. Omitted arguments keep their value; an empty string clears it.
connectVenueSquare staffql only
input: VenueSquareConnectInput!		 VenueSquareConnectPayload Starts connecting a venue’s Square account so it can take cover in the apps. Send its manager to authorizeUrl; Square brings them back to returnTo with square=connected, pick_location (pick one with setVenueSquareLocation), declined or error.
connectVenueStripe staffql only
input: VenueStripeConnectInput!		 VenueStripeConnectPayload Starts connecting a venue’s Stripe account so it can take cover in the apps. Send its manager to onboardingUrl; Stripe brings them back to returnTo with stripe=connected (or pending, or error).
createAppReviewCode staffql only
input: AppReviewCodeCreateInput!		 AppReviewCodeCreatePayload Creates or replaces the demo review code and refreshes its sample nights.
createAppearance staffql only
input: AppearanceCreateInput!		 AppearanceCreatePayload Puts someone on at a venue: hosting, DJing, performing or MCing, with or without an event. An event’s hosts add to its lineup only (eventId).
createEvent staffql only
input: EventCreateInput!		 EventCreatePayload Adds an event at one of the audience’s venues.
createEventSeries staffql only
input: EventSeriesCreateInput!		 EventSeriesCreatePayload Adds a recurring series run by one of the audience’s venues or people, and puts its occurrences on the calendar.
createLocale staffql only
input: LocaleCreateInput!		 LocaleCreatePayload Adds a locale to the audience: a city or neighborhood its venues are in.
createPerson staffql only
input: PersonCreateInput!		 PersonCreatePayload Adds talent by name, before they have a Facebook Page. Link one later with linkPersonFacebook.
createPost staffql only
input: PostCreateInput!		 PostCreatePayload Posts as a venue on the venue, one of its events or one of its series. Name exactly one of them.
createPostComment
input: PostCommentCreateInput!		 PostCommentCreatePayload Comments on a venue’s post, as the signed-in user. Someone banned from the venue’s chat can’t.
createTag staffql only
input: TagCreateInput!		 TagCreatePayload Adds a tag to the audience’s list.
createVenue staffql only
input: VenueCreateInput!		 VenueCreatePayload Adds a venue to the audience: a bar, club or other place that holds events.
deleteAccount
input: AccountDeleteInput!		 AccountDeletePayload Deletes the signed-in user’s account and everything recorded about them (see UserDataEraser), and signs them out everywhere. It can’t be undone.
deleteAppearance staffql only
input: AppearanceDeleteInput!		 AppearanceDeletePayload Takes someone off a venue’s lineup.
deleteEvent staffql only
input: EventDeleteInput!		 EventDeletePayload Deletes one of the audience’s events, with its RSVPs. Canceling it keeps it listed instead. Deleting an occurrence of a series skips its date.
deleteEventSeries staffql only
input: EventSeriesDeleteInput!		 EventSeriesDeletePayload Deletes one of the audience’s recurring series with its upcoming occurrences, except ones edited on their own or that people have RSVPed to. Past occurrences stay as ordinary events.
deleteLocale staffql only
input: LocaleDeleteInput!		 LocaleDeletePayload Deletes one of the audience’s locales. Its venues must be moved or deleted first.
deletePerson staffql only
input: PersonDeleteInput!		 PersonDeletePayload Removes a person from the audience. Their Facebook Page stays known to AudienceKit.
deletePost staffql only
input: PostDeleteInput!		 PostDeletePayload Removes a venue’s post and its comments from the apps.
deleteTag staffql only
input: TagDeleteInput!		 TagDeletePayload Removes one of the audience’s tags, and takes it off everything it was applied to. A facet tag (Tag.facet) only goes while nothing has its facet on; the facet makes it again when it is next needed.
deleteVenue staffql only
input: VenueDeleteInput!		 VenueDeletePayload Deletes one of the audience’s venues and its events. Hiding it keeps them instead.
disconnectTicketingAccount staffql only
input: TicketingAccountDisconnectInput!		 TicketingAccountDisconnectPayload Disconnects a ticketing account and stops its webhook. Events imported from it stay.
disconnectVenueKaraoke staffql only
input: VenueKaraokeDisconnectInput!		 VenueKaraokeDisconnectPayload Disconnects a venue from its karaoke partner and forgets its API token. Its karaoke nights stay karaoke nights, without a session.
disconnectVenuePayments staffql only
input: VenuePaymentsDisconnectInput!		 VenuePaymentsDisconnectPayload Stops a venue taking cover through its Stripe or Square account. The account stays for the covers already paid through it, and connecting one again starts over.
endPing
input: PingEndInput!		 PingEndPayload Ends the signed-in user’s ping.
grantObjectAccess staffql only
input: AccessGrantCreateInput!		 AccessGrantCreatePayload Grants access on a subject (Venue, Person, Locale) to a user with an action (admin, write, read).
hideEventPhoto staffql only
input: EventPhotoHideInput!		 EventPhotoHidePayload Hides a photographer’s photo from the apps in this audience. The photographer publishing it again doesn’t bring it back; showing it does.
identifyWithTribe
input: TribeIdentifyInput!		 TribeIdentifyPayload Identifies the signed-in user with one of the audience’s tribes, or changes whether that’s private. Private is the default: only people in the same tribe see it.
issueVenueDevice staffql only
input: VenueDeviceIssueInput!		 VenueDeviceIssuePayload Issues a one-time device code with permissions for this venue.
joinPing
input: PingJoinInput!		 PingJoinPayload Says the signed-in user is in for a ping, for one pick or (with no target) the whole ping.
kickAudienceMember staffql only
input: AudienceMemberKickInput!		 AudienceMemberKickPayload Signs a member out of the audience everywhere and drops them from any chat they have open. They can sign in again.
leavePing
input: PingLeaveInput!		 PingLeavePayload Takes the signed-in user out of a ping they’re in.
leaveTribe
input: TribeLeaveInput!		 TribeLeavePayload Removes the signed-in user from one of the tribes they identify with. Nothing is kept.
linkPersonFacebook staffql only
input: PersonLinkFacebookInput!		 PersonLinkFacebookPayload Links talent to a Facebook Page or profile, adding the person when no personId is given. People added by name with createPerson are linked here once their Page is known.
matchVenueTicketmaster staffql only
input: VenueMatchTicketmasterInput!		 VenueMatchTicketmasterPayload Links a venue to its Ticketmaster venue, so the scheduled import reads its Ticketmaster events. Without ticketmasterVenueId, looks it up by name near the venue.
mergeLocale staffql only
input: LocaleMergeInput!		 LocaleMergePayload Moves a locale into another locale in this audience, preserving its records and deleting the source.
moderateVenueChat staffql only
input: VenueChatModerateInput!		 VenueChatModeratePayload Kicks someone out of one venue chat, or bans or unbans them from the venue, without changing their audience access. A venue ban keeps them out of its chat and takes away their view of the venue, its events and lineups (Ability::AT_VENUE). Staff can only moderate people who were at the venue; platform admins can ban any member.
payCover
input: CoverPayInput!		 CoverPayPayload Pays a Square venue’s cover with a payment token from Square’s In-App Payments SDK (a card, Apple Pay or Google Pay), after buyCover. The pass works as soon as this returns it paid.
payTip
input: TipPayInput!		 TipPayPayload Pays a tip to a performer who takes Square with a payment token from Square’s In-App Payments SDK (a card, Apple Pay or Google Pay), after startTip.
pinChatMessage staffql only
input: ChatMessagePinInput!		 ChatMessagePinPayload Pins an announcement under its chat room’s title, replacing the one pinned there, or unpins it.
pushEventToEventbrite staffql only
input: EventPushToEventbriteInput!		 EventPushToEventbritePayload Puts an event created in the console on Eventbrite now: a draft the first time, updated after that. With publish, it goes public too, once it has tickets on Eventbrite; the organizer’s “Add to Facebook” setting on Eventbrite then puts it on their Facebook Page.
refreshInstagram staffql only
input: InstagramRefreshInput!		 InstagramRefreshPayload Queues an import of a linked public Instagram profile.
refreshPage staffql only
input: PageRefreshInput!		 PageRefreshPayload Refreshes a venue’s or person’s Page from Facebook now instead of waiting for the scheduled refresh.
refundAdmission
input: AdmissionRefundInput!		 AdmissionRefundPayload Refunds a cover. Buyers can refund their own until it’s scanned at the door or the night is over; the venue’s door staff and the audience’s admins can refund any paid cover.
refundTip staffql only
input: TipRefundInput!		 TipRefundPayload Refunds a paid tip from the performer’s account. Admins only.
registerDevice
input: DeviceRegisterInput!		 DeviceRegisterPayload Stores the push notification token for the device this session signed in on.
removeAppReviewCode staffql only
input: AppReviewCodeRemoveInput!		 AppReviewCodeRemovePayload Removes an App Review code linked to its own test account (AppReviewCode); the account stays. Platform administrators only.
removeChatMessage staffql only
input: ChatMessageRemoveInput!		 ChatMessageRemovePayload Removes a message from its chat room. Everyone in the room stops seeing it at once; the console’s transcript keeps it, marked removed, with the reason.
removeMyChatMessage
input: ChatMessageRemoveOwnInput!		 ChatMessageRemoveOwnPayload Removes one of your own messages from its chat room. Everyone in the room stops seeing it at once.
removePostComment
input: PostCommentRemoveInput!		 PostCommentRemovePayload Removes a comment on a venue’s post: its author’s own, or any on the venue’s posts for its managers and admins.
removeVenueBannerPhoto staffql only
input: VenueBannerPhotoRemoveInput!		 VenueBannerPhotoRemovePayload Takes an image out of a venue’s banner images.
reorderLineup staffql only
input: LineupReorderInput!		 LineupReorderPayload Puts a night’s lineups in a new running order. Each entry stays on its own lineup (the venue’s or an event’s): only the order within each changes.
reorderVenueBannerPhotos staffql only
input: VenueBannerPhotosReorderInput!		 VenueBannerPhotosReorderPayload Puts a venue’s banner images in this order. Name each of them once.
reportChatMessage
input: ChatMessageReportInput!		 ChatMessageReportPayload Reports a message in a venue’s or locale’s chat room to the audience’s admins, who see it in the console’s Reports queue at once and can remove it or ban the sender. Optionally blocks the sender too. A post as the venue or as a person can be reported like any other; blocking ignores it, since a listing has no sender to block. Same as reportContent with MESSAGE.
reportContent
input: ContentReportInput!		 ContentReportPayload Reports a message, person, venue, ping or photo to the audience’s admins, who see it in the console’s Reports queue at once. Optionally blocks the person responsible, when there is one: a message’s sender (not for posts as the venue or a person), the person themself, a ping’s sender.
reportEventPhoto
input: EventPhotoReportInput!		 EventPhotoReportPayload Reports a photographer’s photo, for example a photo of yourself you want taken down. It’s hidden at once, until the audience’s admins look at it in the console’s Reports queue; the photographer sees it was reported. reportContent with PHOTO does the same.
reportLocation
input: LocationReportInput!		 LocationReportPayload Records the user’s position and returns the venue they’re in, or what’s near them.
requestSong
input: SongRequestCreateInput!		 SongRequestCreatePayload Asks for a song, or signs up to sing one, in a venue’s chat room. Everyone in the room sees the REQUEST line, and the host finds it in the queue. Refused while the venue is not taking requests of that kind (see Venue.requests for why).
resetAppReview staffql only
input: AppReviewResetInput!		 AppReviewResetPayload Does what rake app_review:reset does: resets the sandbox reviewer account, refreshes the demo venue and its sample nights, sets the review code and turns App Review on for Hot Mess and AudienceKit Demo (AppReviewState). It also resets the second reviewer, banned from one Hot Mess venue, with its own code (AppReviewCode). Platform administrators only.
resetAudienceInvite staffql only
input: AudienceInviteResetInput!		 AudienceInviteResetPayload Makes a new invite link for the audience. The old link stops working; people who already joined keep their listings.
resolveContentReport staffql only
input: ContentReportResolveInput!		 ContentReportResolvePayload Resolves a report in the audience’s Reports queue, and the other open reports on the same thing. removeContent takes the content down first (removes the message, hides the photo, ends the ping); banUser bans the person responsible from the audience, as banAudienceMember does.
revokeObjectAccess staffql only
input: AccessGrantRevokeInput!		 AccessGrantRevokePayload Revokes an access grant from a subject.
revokeVenueDevice staffql only
input: VenueDeviceRevokeInput!		 VenueDeviceRevokePayload Revokes a venue device and its unused code.
rsvpEvent
input: EventRSVPInput!		 EventRSVPPayload Sets the user’s RSVP to an event in AudienceKit. It isn’t sent to Facebook, which no longer lets apps RSVP for people. A ticket holder stays going whatever they answer.
scanAdmission staffql only
input: AdmissionScanInput!		 AdmissionScanPayload Checks a pass’s QR code at a venue’s door. The first scan of a paid pass checks them in; later ones that night are re-entry.
sendChatMessage staffql only
input: ChatMessageSendInput!		 ChatMessageSendPayload Posts to a venue’s or a locale’s chat room, as the signed-in admin (STAFF), as the venue (VENUE) or as a person (HOST). Everyone in the room sees it at once. Admins post as any; venue listing managers only as their venue; talent as a person they manage, in the rooms of the venues and locales they’re featured in or host events at (Person.chat.rooms), from anywhere: text, a PHOTO or one of their EVENTs.
sendMyChatMessage
input: ChatMessageSendOwnInput!		 ChatMessageSendOwnPayload Says something in a chat room as yourself. The message reaches everyone following the room at once.
sendPing
input: PingSendInput!		 PingSendPayload Tells friends the signed-in user wants to go out tonight, naming venues or events, or neither.
setAudienceAdmin staffql only
input: AudienceAdminSetInput!		 AudienceAdminSetPayload Makes a member one of the audience’s admins, or not. Takes effect when they next sign in.
setCoverNight staffql only
input: CoverNightSetInput!		 CoverNightSetPayload Changes one night’s cover at a venue whose door the caller works: another price, none, or other hours. It wins over the usual cover and over an event that night.
setEventKaraoke staffql only
input: EventKaraokeSetInput!		 EventKaraokeSetPayload Marks an event as a karaoke night, or not, and links it to the session singers join that night on its venue’s karaoke partner. Without a session code of its own, a night uses its venue’s standing one.
setPersonLocale staffql only
input: PersonLocaleSetInput!		 PersonLocaleSetPayload Features a person in one of the audience’s locales, or stops featuring them there.
setPersonSquareLocation staffql only
input: PersonSquareLocationSetInput!		 PersonSquareLocationSetPayload Picks which of a performer’s Square locations their tips are paid to.
setRecentChatPush
input: RecentChatPushSetInput!		 RecentChatPushSetPayload Turns on or off pushes about new messages in chat rooms the signed-in user left in the last 30 minutes (at most one every 10 minutes per room). Off until they turn it on.
setSongRequestState staffql only
input: SongRequestSetStateInput!		 SongRequestSetStatePayload Moves a song request or karaoke signup along: UP calls it (playing now, or the singer is on, announced in the room; whatever was up goes back to QUEUED), DONE and SKIPPED finish it, QUEUED puts it back. For admins, the venue’s managers and the host on now.
setVenueSquareLocation staffql only
input: VenueSquareLocationSetInput!		 VenueSquareLocationSetPayload Picks which of the venue’s Square locations its cover is paid to.
showEventPhoto staffql only
input: EventPhotoShowInput!		 EventPhotoShowPayload Shows a hidden or reported photo in the apps again.
startMaintenanceRun staffql only
input: MaintenanceRunStartInput!		 MaintenanceRunStartPayload Starts a maintenance operation on the worker. On an audience’s endpoint it runs for that audience; on the tenants endpoint it runs for audienceId, or platform-wide without one.
startTip
input: TipStartInput!		 TipStartPayload Starts tipping a performer in the app, through their own Stripe or Square account (the IN_APP option of their tipping mixin). Stripe: finish with Stripe’s payment sheet (paymentIntentClientSecret, on their account stripeAccountId, with publishableKey), then call confirmTip. Square: make a payment token with Square’s In-App Payments SDK (squareApplicationId, squareLocationId), then call payTip with it. Asking again for the same amount soon after returns the same tip.
unbanAudienceMember staffql only
input: AudienceMemberUnbanInput!		 AudienceMemberUnbanPayload Lets a banned member sign in and chat again.
unblockUser
input: BlockedUserRemoveInput!		 BlockedUserRemovePayload Unblocks someone the signed-in user blocked.
updateAppearance staffql only
input: AppearanceUpdateInput!		 AppearanceUpdatePayload Changes someone’s appearance at a venue.
updateAudience staffql only
input: AudienceUpdateInput!		 AudienceUpdatePayload Renames an audience, changes its subdomain, links its Facebook Page, sets the App Review period of its apps or chooses how people sign in to its apps and the warnings they see first. Subdomains and Pages change only from /v1/tenants/graphql.
updateAudienceTheme staffql only
input: AudienceThemeUpdateInput!		 AudienceThemeUpdatePayload Replaces an audience’s theme: its design system preset, tagline and color overrides.
updateChatMessage staffql only
input: ChatMessageUpdateInput!		 ChatMessageUpdatePayload Edits an announcement or special: its title, its body, or when a special ends. An endsAt of now or earlier ends the special at once.
updateEvent staffql only
input: EventUpdateInput!		 EventUpdatePayload Changes one of the audience’s events.
updateEventSeries staffql only
input: EventSeriesUpdateInput!		 EventSeriesUpdatePayload Changes one of the audience’s recurring series. Its upcoming occurrences follow, except ones edited on their own.
updateLocale staffql only
input: LocaleUpdateInput!		 LocaleUpdatePayload Changes one of the audience’s locales.
updatePerson staffql only
input: PersonUpdateInput!		 PersonUpdatePayload Changes one of the audience’s people. Listing managers change only their own name, website, photo and social links, and those of troupes they are in, all but the troupe’s tip links.
updatePhotographer staffql only
input: PhotographerUpdateInput!		 PhotographerUpdatePayload Changes a photographer’s grant: their name, the metros it covers, or whether it’s revoked. Revoking hides every photo credited to them here; restoring shows them again.
updatePost staffql only
input: PostUpdateInput!		 PostUpdatePayload Changes a venue’s post. Fields left out aren’t changed.
updateTag staffql only
input: TagUpdateInput!		 TagUpdatePayload Renames or recolors one of the audience’s tags, everywhere it is applied.
updateTicketingAccount staffql only
input: TicketingAccountUpdateInput!		 TicketingAccountUpdatePayload Changes a connected ticketing account, and with sync imports its events again now.
updateVenue staffql only
input: VenueUpdateInput!		 VenueUpdatePayload Changes one of the audience’s venues. Listing managers change only the name, description, website, social links and cover of their own.
updateVenueCover staffql only
input: VenueCoverUpdateInput!		 VenueCoverUpdatePayload Sets the usual cover for a venue whose door the caller manages.
verifyVenueKaraoke staffql only
input: VenueKaraokeVerifyInput!		 VenueKaraokeVerifyPayload Checks a venue’s stored karaoke API token with its partner, without changing anything there.
withdrawSongRequest
input: SongRequestWithdrawInput!		 SongRequestWithdrawPayload Takes back a song request or karaoke signup of yours that is still waiting. Its chat line shows it withdrawn.

Subscription

Section titled “Subscription”
Field Type Description
chatModeration staffql only
after: ID		 ChatModerationEvent! The audience’s moderation feed, for its remote moderation provider: every event after after, then each new one as it happens.
chatRooms staffql only ChatRoom! Follows the audience’s chat rooms, as chat { rooms } lists them: a room, fresh, whenever someone joins or leaves it or its messages change (posted, edited, removed, cleared). Admins hear every room; venue listing managers their own venues. Nothing arrives on subscribing.
door staffql only
venueId: ID!		 DoorEvent! Follows a venue’s door for tonight: DoorOpened, then every cover that’s paid, scanned in or refunded, with fresh totals. For whoever may work the door: its admins, its listing managers, and a venue device with door.
edgeChanged
edge: String
id: ID!		 EdgeChanged! Follows a record’s lists (a venue’s events, an event’s appearances): an event whenever a member joins, leaves or changes, carrying the member as you may read it. Name an edge to hear about one list only.
localeChat
localeId: ID!
watch: Boolean		 ChatRoomEvent! Follows a locale’s chat room, for people out in the locale and not at a venue: ChatJoined, then everything the room says and who comes and goes, until ChatLeft. The room’s admins join from anywhere.
myNotifications PushNotification! Your notifications while the app is open, in concert with your devices’ push service: each push sent to you (a friend’s ping, a reply) arrives here too, with the notificationId the device copy carries, so the app shows it itself and skips the system banner. Nothing arrives on subscribing.
nodeChanged
id: ID!		 NodeChanged! Follows a record by its ID: an event whenever it changes or is deleted, carrying the record as you may read it then, so you select what you show and need no refetch. Any Node you can see; nothing arrives until it changes.
venueChat
venueId: ID!
watch: Boolean		 ChatRoomEvent! Follows a venue’s chat room: ChatJoined, then everything the room says and who comes and goes, until ChatLeft. Open to people at the venue, and to the room’s admins from anywhere.

Admission

Section titled “Admission”

Object · implements Node

Someone’s cover for one night at a venue, and their pass. See CoverPass for the QR code.

Field Type Description
amount Money! The cover.
checkedInAt ISO8601DateTime When the door first scanned it.
claimCheckNumber String Coat check hanger or claim number.
createdAt ISO8601DateTime! When the record was created.
event Event The event that night, if it set the cover.
fee Money! The Hot Mess fee.
id ID! Unique identifier.
isRefundable Boolean! Whether the buyer can refund it themselves: paid, not scanned in, and the night isn’t over.
kind AdmissionKindEnum! The kind of pass (cover or coat_check).
night ISO8601Date! The local date of the cover night.
passCode String The pass QR code right now, for clients that don’t make their own. Changes every 30 seconds. The buyer only.
passSecret String The Base64 key the app makes the pass QR code with. The buyer only; null for everyone else.
profile Profile! The buyer: their name for the door and the console, their picture so the door can match faces.
quantity Int! Number of covers in this admission.
scanCount Int! How many times the door has scanned it.
status AdmissionStatus! Current payment status.
tier String The cover tier, e.g. general, vip.
total Money! What the buyer paid.
venue Venue! The venue associated with this record.

Appearance

Section titled “Appearance”

Object · implements Node

An entry in a lineup: someone (or several people) on, or an intermission. A lineup is a venue night’s own, built as the night goes, or an event’s, built ahead. Each runs in position order and can be advanced like a slide deck (advanceLineup).

Field Type Description
cameOffAt ISO8601DateTime When advancing (or finishing it) took it off.
endTiming AppearanceEndTiming! How it ends.
endsAt ISO8601DateTime Its set end time; null until close or advanced.
event Event The event whose lineup it’s on, built ahead; null for one on the venue night’s own lineup.
id ID! Its UUID.
kind AppearanceKind! An act or an intermission.
night ISO8601Date! The venue night it is on.
people
after: String
before: String
first: Int
last: Int		 PersonConnection! Who’s on it, in billing order: two for a duet.
person Person Who, or the first of them; null for an intermission.
position Int! Its place in its lineup’s running order, from 0.
role AppearanceRole What they are doing; null for an intermission.
songRequest SongRequest A singer’s karaoke signup: the song, artist and who is singing it; null for everything else.
startTiming AppearanceStartTiming! How it starts.
startsAt ISO8601DateTime Its set (hard or soft) time, or when an entry with no set time went on; null until then.
state AppearanceState! Upcoming, on now or done.
title String An act’s billing (a duet’s name) or an intermission’s label, if it has one.
venue Venue! Where.
wentOnAt ISO8601DateTime When advancing put it on.

until TimeOfDay When the cover ends, local time, e.g. 02:00.

VenueKaraokeView

Section titled “VenueKaraokeView”

Object · implements IVenueKaraoke

The local Karaoke implementation of a venue’s karaoke defaults.

Field Type Description
accounts [IKaraokeAccount!] Its connections to karaoke partners, each as its provider shows it. Admins and its listing managers only; null for everyone else.
joinUrl String The partner’s page singers open to join its standing session. Null without one.
provider String Its karaoke partner, e.g. karafun. Null until it connects one.
providerName String The partner’s name, e.g. KaraFun.
queue [KaraokeQueueEntry!] The singer queue of its standing session, soonest first, when its partner lets the server read one (AudienceKit: tonight’s karaoke signups from the chat). Null otherwise.
sessionCode String Its standing session on the partner, e.g. a KaraFun remote code. Null when it has none, or the partner has no sessions.

VenueMessage

Section titled “VenueMessage”

Object · implements ChatMessage, HasTribes, Node

A message someone sent in a venue’s chat room.

Field Type Description
automatic Boolean! Whether the server posted it on its own, like an “On now” announcement.
avatarUrl PhotoURL The sender’s profile photo, or the venue’s photo for a post as the venue.
body String! What they wrote: the text, or a rich message’s body or caption (may be empty).
endsAt ISO8601DateTime When a special stops showing.
event Event The event an event message shares.
id ID! The ID of the message.
kind ChatKind! What the message is.
member AudienceMember The sender’s membership in the room’s audience, for kicking or banning them. Admins only; null for anyone else.
message String! The message as apps that only show text show it: the text, or a rich message in words (“Shared an event: Sunset Social”).
name String The sender’s name: in full for themself, their friends and admins; first name and last initial (“Aurora B.”) for anyone else, as the room shows it. The venue’s name for a post as the venue.
person Person The talent listing it was posted as, if any.
photoUrl PhotoURL The photo of a photo message or an announcement.
pinned Boolean! Whether it’s the announcement pinned under the room’s title.
postedAsPerson Boolean! Whether talent posted it as their listing (role HOST): person is who.
postedAsVenue Boolean! Whether it was posted as the venue.
presence Presence! Whether they can be reached now: in chat, by push, or neither. OFFLINE unless the viewer is them, a friend of theirs, or an admin.
removal ChatMessageRemoval Who removed it and why, for a removed message in a transcript asked with includeRemoved; null while it shows.
request SongRequest The song request or karaoke signup a REQUEST message made, with its place in the queue and what became of it.
role ChatRole Their role in the room, if any.
sentAt ISO8601DateTime! When they sent it.
title String An announcement or special’s headline.
tribes [TribeIdentification!]! Their tribes here that the signed-in user may see: their public ones, and private ones only in tribes the viewer is in too.
userId ID! The ID of the user who sent it.

VenuePeopleView

Section titled “VenuePeopleView”

Object · implements IVenuePeople

The local People implementation of who is on at a venue.

Field Type Description
lineup
after: String
before: String
first: Int
last: Int
night: ISO8601Date		 AppearanceConnection! The acts on a night that have a time (or have gone on), in running order.
onNow
after: String
before: String
first: Int
last: Int		 AppearanceConnection! The acts on there right now.
onStage Appearance What tonight’s lineup is on now, an act or an intermission: what advancing takes off. Null before the show starts and after it ends. The lineup is the one with something on stage, else the started event’s, else the venue’s own.
runningOrder
after: String
before: String
first: Int
last: Int
night: ISO8601Date		 AppearanceConnection! Everything on a night’s lineups in order: the venue’s own, then its events’ as they start; intermissions and entries with no set time too.
upNext Appearance What advancing tonight’s running order puts on next.

karaoke SongRequestWindow! Karaoke signups: open while the venue runs karaoke with AudienceKit and a host is on.
song SongRequestWindow! Song requests: open while the venue takes them and a host or DJ is on.
takesRequests Boolean! Whether the venue takes song requests at all (updateVenue songRequests); whether any are open now is song.open.

startTiming staffql only AppearanceStartTiming How it starts. Defaults to HARD.

title staffql only String An act’s billing or an intermission’s label.

VenueInput

Section titled “VenueInput”

Input · staffql only

A venue’s details. Fields left out are not changed.

Field Type Description
chatRetentionMinutes staffql only Int How many minutes its chat room shows a message, 15 to 10080. Null goes back to the default.
coverCents staffql only Int Its cover in cents, e.g. 1000 for $10. Null for none.
coverDays staffql only [Int!] The weekdays the cover applies, 0 for Sunday. Empty for every night.
coverFeePayer staffql only CoverFeePayer Who pays the card and Hot Mess fees.
coverFrom staffql only TimeOfDay When the cover starts each night.
coverTimeZone staffql only String The time zone its nights are counted in, e.g. America/Los_Angeles.
coverUntil staffql only TimeOfDay When the cover ends each night.
description staffql only String What it is like, for its page in the apps.
distanceTolerance staffql only Int Metres from its location that count as being there.
facebookGroupName staffql only String The linked public group’s display name.
facebookGroupPublicConfirmed staffql only Boolean Staff confirms that the linked group is public.
facebookPage staffql only String Its Facebook Page’s ID or username, from Query.facebook.search. An empty string unlinks it.
googlePlaceId staffql only String Its Google place ID, from Query.places.search or Google Maps. Its address and coordinates come from Google when the server has a Google API key.
hidden staffql only Boolean Hidden venues are left out of the apps.
karaokePaused staffql only Boolean Pauses karaoke signups for tonight: the singers already on the lineup still sing, nobody new signs up (Venue.requests.karaoke.paused). Lifts when the night ends.
localeId staffql only ID The locale it belongs to. Required to create one.
name staffql only String Its name. Defaults to its Facebook Page’s.
order staffql only Int Lower comes first.
phone staffql only String Its public phone number, shown instead of its Google place’s. An empty string goes back to the place’s.
photo staffql only String A photo of the place: an image URL, or an image uploaded as a data: URI (10 MB at most). It is shown as bannerUrl when it has no banner images, and as photoUrl when there is no Facebook Page. An empty string removes it.
profilePhoto staffql only String Its profile picture, shown instead of its Facebook Page’s: an image URL, or an image uploaded as a data: URI. An empty string goes back to the Page’s.
socialLinks staffql only [SocialLinkInput!] Its profiles (Instagram, TikTok, …), all of them. Replaces the ones it has; an empty list removes them. Its Facebook Page is facebookPage.
songRequests staffql only Boolean Whether its chat takes song requests for whoever is on, while a host or DJ is on the lineup (Venue.requests.song).
tagIds staffql only [ID!] The audience’s tags on it, all of them: tags left out are taken off. Admins only.
website staffql only String Its website.

Interfaces

Section titled “Interfaces”

ChatMessage

Section titled “ChatMessage”

Interface

A message in a venue’s or a locale’s chat room: a VenueMessage or a LocaleMessage.

Field Type Description
automatic Boolean! Whether the server posted it on its own, like an “On now” announcement.
avatarUrl PhotoURL The sender’s profile photo, or the venue’s photo for a post as the venue.
body String! What they wrote: the text, or a rich message’s body or caption (may be empty).
endsAt ISO8601DateTime When a special stops showing.
event Event The event an event message shares.
id ID! The ID of the message.
kind ChatKind! What the message is.
member AudienceMember The sender’s membership in the room’s audience, for kicking or banning them. Admins only; null for anyone else.
message String! The message as apps that only show text show it: the text, or a rich message in words (“Shared an event: Sunset Social”).
name String The sender’s name: in full for themself, their friends and admins; first name and last initial (“Aurora B.”) for anyone else, as the room shows it. The venue’s name for a post as the venue.
person Person The talent listing it was posted as, if any.
photoUrl PhotoURL The photo of a photo message or an announcement.
pinned Boolean! Whether it’s the announcement pinned under the room’s title.
postedAsPerson Boolean! Whether talent posted it as their listing (role HOST): person is who.
postedAsVenue Boolean! Whether it was posted as the venue.
presence Presence! Whether they can be reached now: in chat, by push, or neither. OFFLINE unless the viewer is them, a friend of theirs, or an admin.
removal ChatMessageRemoval Who removed it and why, for a removed message in a transcript asked with includeRemoved; null while it shows.
request SongRequest The song request or karaoke signup a REQUEST message made, with its place in the queue and what became of it.
role ChatRole Their role in the room, if any.
sentAt ISO8601DateTime! When they sent it.
title String An announcement or special’s headline.
userId ID! The ID of the user who sent it.

last: Int		 FriendConnection! The signed-in user’s friends who have been here lately, by name.

IVenueKaraoke

Section titled “IVenueKaraoke”

Interface

A venue’s karaoke: its connections to karaoke partners, and the defaults its karaoke nights use unless they have their own. A facet: only venues connected to a partner have it.

Field Type Description
accounts [IKaraokeAccount!] Its connections to karaoke partners, each as its provider shows it. Admins and its listing managers only; null for everyone else.
joinUrl String The partner’s page singers open to join its standing session. Null without one.
provider String Its karaoke partner, e.g. karafun. Null until it connects one.
providerName String The partner’s name, e.g. KaraFun.
queue [KaraokeQueueEntry!] The singer queue of its standing session, soonest first, when its partner lets the server read one (AudienceKit: tonight’s karaoke signups from the chat). Null otherwise.
sessionCode String Its standing session on the partner, e.g. a KaraFun remote code. Null when it has none, or the partner has no sessions.

IVenueMusic

Section titled “IVenueMusic”

Interface

Live music reported by equipment linked to this venue.

Field Type Description
nowPlaying EquipmentTrack Latest track while equipment reporting is active.

IVenuePeople

Section titled “IVenuePeople”

Interface

Who is on at a venue (Appearance), with or without an event: its lineup, running order and who’s on now.

Field Type Description
lineup
after: String
before: String
first: Int
last: Int
night: ISO8601Date		 AppearanceConnection! The acts on a night that have a time (or have gone on), in running order.
onNow
after: String
before: String
first: Int
last: Int		 AppearanceConnection! The acts on there right now.
onStage Appearance What tonight’s lineup is on now, an act or an intermission: what advancing takes off. Null before the show starts and after it ends. The lineup is the one with something on stage, else the started event’s, else the venue’s own.
runningOrder
after: String
before: String
first: Int
last: Int
night: ISO8601Date		 AppearanceConnection! Everything on a night’s lineups in order: the venue’s own, then its events’ as they start; intermissions and entries with no set time too.
upNext Appearance What advancing tonight’s running order puts on next.

IVenueRequests

Section titled “IVenueRequests”

Interface

Requests from a venue’s chat: song requests for whoever is on, and karaoke signups. Each kind has its own queue and is open only while the venue permits it and a host is on the lineup.

Field Type Description
karaoke SongRequestWindow! Karaoke signups: open while the venue runs karaoke with AudienceKit and a host is on.
song SongRequestWindow! Song requests: open while the venue takes them and a host or DJ is on.
takesRequests Boolean! Whether the venue takes song requests at all (updateVenue songRequests); whether any are open now is song.open.

offers
after: String
before: String
first: Int
last: Int
night: ISO8601Date		 IAdmissionOfferConnection! Every way in that night, whichever module sells it: the venue’s cover, and tickets on the live partner listings of that night’s events.

Enums

Section titled “Enums”

AdmissionKindEnum

Section titled “AdmissionKindEnum”

Enum

The kind of admission or service pass.

  • COAT_CHECK A coat check claim ticket pass.
  • COVER A cover pass to enter the venue.

AdmissionStatus

Section titled “AdmissionStatus”

Enum

Where a cover payment stands.

  • CANCELED The payment was abandoned.
  • DISPUTED The buyer disputed the charge with their bank.
  • FAILED The payment was declined.
  • PAID Paid: the pass works.
  • PENDING Paying in the app has started but not finished.
  • REFUNDED The money went back; the pass no longer works.

AppearanceEndTiming

Section titled “AppearanceEndTiming”

Enum

How a lineup entry ends.

  • ADVANCE When the venue advances to what is next.
  • CLOSE When the night ends.
  • TIME At its end time.

AppearanceKind

Section titled “AppearanceKind”

Enum

What a lineup entry is.

  • ACT Someone (or several people) on: hosting, DJing, performing or MCing.
  • INTERMISSION A break in the show.

AppearanceRole

Section titled “AppearanceRole”

Enum

What someone is doing at a venue.

  • DJ DJing.
  • HOST Hosting.
  • MC MCing.
  • PERFORMER Performing, e.g. a drag or live act.
  • SINGER Singing karaoke: a signup, with its song as songRequest.

AppearanceStartTiming

Section titled “AppearanceStartTiming”

Enum

How a lineup entry starts.

  • HARD At its time, by the clock (or earlier, if advanced to).
  • NONE No set time: when the venue advances to it.
  • SOFT Around its time: when the venue advances to it.

AppearanceState

Section titled “AppearanceState”

Enum

Where a lineup entry is in its night.

  • DONE Finished, or its night is over.
  • ON On now.
  • UPCOMING Hasn’t gone on yet.

AudienceActivityKind

Section titled “AudienceActivityKind”

Enum · staffql only

What an AudienceActivity records.

  • BANNED
  • BUG_REPORTED
  • CHAT_CLEARED
  • CHAT_MESSAGE
  • CHAT_REMOVED
  • CHAT_REPORTED
  • CHECKED_IN
  • CONTENT_REPORTED
  • COVER_PAID
  • COVER_REFUNDED
  • ENTERED_VENUE
  • KICKED
  • PHOTO_REPORTED
  • SIGN_IN
  • TIP_PAID
  • TIP_REFUNDED
  • UNBANNED
  • USER_BLOCKED
  • USER_CREATED

ChatKind

Section titled “ChatKind”

Enum

What a chat message is. Only messages with a role can be anything but TEXT or REQUEST.

  • ANNOUNCEMENT A title, the message as its body and an optional photo. One per room can be pinned under its title.
  • EVENT One of the audience’s events, with the message as a caption.
  • PHOTO A photo, with the message as a caption.
  • REQUEST A song request or karaoke signup (request), with the message as a note to the host. Anyone in a venue room may send one while the venue takes them (requestSong).
  • SPECIAL A title and body that stop showing at endsAt.
  • TEXT Just what they wrote.

ChatLeftReason

Section titled “ChatLeftReason”

Enum

Why someone is out of a chat room.

  • AWAY They’re no longer at the venue (or in the locale) and tried to speak.
  • BANNED The room’s audience banned them.
  • REMOVED The venue’s moderators kicked or banned them from its room.

ChatModerationAction

Section titled “ChatModerationAction”

Enum · staffql only

What a moderator does to a person in one venue chat.

  • BAN Drops them and keeps them out of this room.
  • KICK Drops them from the room now; they may come back.
  • UNBAN Lets a banned person back in.

ChatModerationCategory

Section titled “ChatModerationCategory”

Enum · staffql only

The moderation policy’s categories (Moderation::CATEGORIES), most severe first.

  • DOXXING The policy’s doxxing category.
  • DRUG_SALES The policy’s drug sales category.
  • HATE The policy’s hate category.
  • MINORS The policy’s minors category.
  • OUTING The policy’s outing category.
  • SELF_HARM The policy’s self harm category.
  • SEX_WORK The policy’s sex work category.
  • SPAM The policy’s spam category.
  • THREATS The policy’s threats category.
  • UNSAFE_VENUE The policy’s unsafe venue category.

ChatModerationProviderAction

Section titled “ChatModerationProviderAction”

Enum · staffql only

What a moderation provider did (Moderation::ACTIONS).

  • BAN_USER The ban user action.
  • ESCALATE The escalate action.
  • KICK_USER The kick user action.
  • NOTIFY_ADMINS The notify admins action.
  • NOTIFY_VENUE The notify venue action.
  • REMOVE_MESSAGE The remove message action.
  • RESOLVE_APPEAL The resolve appeal action.
  • RESTORE_MESSAGE The restore message action.
  • UNBAN_USER The unban user action.
  • WARN_USER The warn user action.

ChatModerationRoomKind

Section titled “ChatModerationRoomKind”

Enum · staffql only

Whose chat room an event in the moderation feed happened in.

  • LOCALE A locale’s room.
  • VENUE A venue’s room.

ChatRole

Section titled “ChatRole”

Enum

Who a chat message is from, when they have a role there (see ChatMessage). Set by the server.

  • HOST A host or performer on tonight’s event at the venue.
  • STAFF One of the audience’s admins.
  • VENUE Posted as the venue, shown with its name and photo.

ClientEnvironment

Section titled “ClientEnvironment”

Enum

Which builds of the apps something is for.

  • DEVELOPMENT Development builds.
  • PRODUCTION The shipped apps.
  • STAGING Staging builds, which name this environment when they sign in.

CoverFeePayer

Section titled “CoverFeePayer”

Enum

Who pays the card fee and the Hot Mess fee on a cover.

  • BUYER Added to the price, so the venue receives the full cover.
  • VENUE Taken from the cover, so the buyer pays the round price.

DoorOutcome

Section titled “DoorOutcome”

Enum · staffql only

What happened to a cover at the door.

  • ADMIT A paid pass was scanned in.
  • PAID A guest paid.
  • REFUND A cover was refunded.
  • RE_ENTRY A pass already scanned in tonight was scanned again.

EdgeChange

Section titled “EdgeChange”

Enum

What happened to a member of a list.

  • ADDED It joined the list: it was created there, or moved there.
  • REMOVED It left the list: it was deleted, or moved elsewhere.
  • UPDATED It changed, and is still in the list.

Endpoint

Section titled “Endpoint”

Enum

A GraphQL endpoint of the API.

  • AUDIENCE An audience’s graph, /v1/audience/:id/graphql: what its apps and websites use.
  • STAFF The same graph with the staff edges, /v1/audience/:id/staffql: StaffKit, the staff apps and the console.
  • TENANTS Platform administration, /v1/tenants/graphql.

EventListingOrigin

Section titled “EventListingOrigin”

Enum

Which side owns an event listing’s details.

  • AUDIENCE_KIT Created here and pushed to the partner.
  • PARTNER Created on the partner, which owns its details.

EventWindow

Section titled “EventWindow”

Enum

Which events to list, by when they happen.

  • PAST Over, most recent first.
  • UPCOMING Not over yet, soonest first.

LiquorRuleConfidence

Section titled “LiquorRuleConfidence”

Enum

How sure the research behind a liquor rule is.

  • HIGH Read in the statute, regulation, code or agency page itself.
  • LOW Not confirmed, or a finding that no rule exists.
  • MEDIUM From the source, with some interpretation or an older copy.

LiquorRuleKind

Section titled “LiquorRuleKind”

Enum

What a liquor rule restricts.

  • CLOSING_TIME When premises must close or patrons leave.
  • CONSUMPTION_END When drinks must be finished or cleared away.
  • HOLIDAY_EXCEPTION Different hours on a holiday, e.g. New Year’s Eve.
  • LATE_NIGHT_PERMIT A license or district that allows later hours.
  • OFF_PREMISE_SALE_END When stores must stop selling.
  • OFF_PREMISE_SALE_START When stores may start selling.
  • OTHER Anything else, including findings that no such rule exists.
  • REENTRY Limits on letting patrons in again, or in at all, late at night.
  • SALE_END The last moment a drink may be sold or served: the legal last call.
  • SALE_START When drinks may first be sold or served.
  • SUNDAY_RULE How Sundays differ.

MaintenanceRunSource

Section titled “MaintenanceRunSource”

Enum · staffql only

What started a maintenance run.

  • CONSOLE An admin, from the console.
  • RAKE A rake task.
  • SCHEDULE The maintenance schedule.

MaintenanceRunStatus

Section titled “MaintenanceRunStatus”

Enum · staffql only

Where a maintenance run is.

  • FAILED Stopped with an error, or never reached the worker.
  • QUEUED Waiting for the worker.
  • RUNNING Running on the worker.
  • SUCCEEDED Finished.

NodeChange

Section titled “NodeChange”

Enum

What happened to a record.

  • DELETED It’s gone.
  • UPDATED It changed: fields says which of its own fields.

PaymentEnvironment

Section titled “PaymentEnvironment”

Enum

Where a payment is taken: production, or Square’s sandbox, which staging builds pay in.

  • PRODUCTION Real payments.
  • SANDBOX Square’s sandbox: test cards, no money moves.

PaymentProvider

Section titled “PaymentProvider”

Enum

Who takes a payment.

  • SQUARE Square; the apps pay with Square’s In-App Payments SDK.
  • STRIPE Stripe Connect; the apps pay with Stripe’s payment sheet.

PersonEventRelationship

Section titled “PersonEventRelationship”

Enum

How a person is on one of their events.

  • DIRECT They host or play it themselves.
  • TROUPE Through a troupe they’re in, which hosts or plays it.

PhotographerStatus

Section titled “PhotographerStatus”

Enum

Whether a photographer’s grant may publish.

  • ACTIVE Publishing.
  • REVOKED Its photos are hidden and it can’t publish.

PingReach

Section titled “PingReach”

Enum

Who sees a ping.

  • FRIENDS Only the sender’s friends.
  • FRIENDS_OF_CIRCLE Friends of anyone in its circle, so it spreads as people join.

Presence

Section titled “Presence”

Enum

Whether someone can be reached right now (see ChatPresence). Only the person themself, their friends and admins see the real value; to anyone else it is always OFFLINE.

  • OFFLINE Neither, or not for this viewer to see.
  • ONLINE Connected to a chat room now.
  • PUSH Not in chat, but signed in on a device that gets push notifications.

ReportResolution

Section titled “ReportResolution”

Enum · staffql only

What an admin did about a report.

  • BANNED Banned the person responsible from the audience.
  • DISMISSED Looked at it and found nothing to act on.
  • REMOVED Took the reported content down.

ReportTarget

Section titled “ReportTarget”

Enum

What kind of thing a report is about (Mutation.reportContent).

  • MESSAGE A message in a venue’s or locale’s chat room, its frame’s id; posts as the venue or as a person included.
  • PERSON A person: a member (their user id, as chat and pings give it) or a talent listing (a Person id).
  • PHOTO A photographer’s photo (an EventPhoto id). It’s hidden until the audience’s admins look at it.
  • PING A ping, by its id.
  • VENUE A venue, by its id.

RSVPSource

Section titled “RSVPSource”

Enum

Why someone counts as going to an event: they said so, or they hold a ticket (a ticket is an RSVP).

  • RSVP They RSVPed attending.
  • TICKET They hold a ticket to it, from the ticketing module or one selling a way in (a paid cover pass for the event’s night).

RSVPState

Section titled “RSVPState”

Enum

Whether the signed-in user is going to an event.

  • ATTENDING Going.
  • DECLINED Not going.
  • MAYBE Interested.
  • UNSURE Not answered yet.

ScanOutcome

Section titled “ScanOutcome”

Enum · staffql only

What the door should do with a scanned pass.

  • ADMIT Paid and first scan tonight: let them in.
  • COAT_CHECK_CLAIM Coat claimed / returned at coat check.
  • COAT_CHECK_IN Coat checked in at coat check.
  • EXPIRED An old code, e.g. a screenshot. Ask them to open the pass.
  • NOT_PAID The cover wasn’t paid, or was refunded or disputed.
  • RE_ENTRY Paid and already scanned in tonight: coming back in.
  • UNREADABLE Not a Hot Mess pass, or one we don’t know.
  • WRONG_VENUE A pass for another venue or another night.

SignInMethod

Section titled “SignInMethod”

Enum

A way of signing in to an audience’s apps and website (Audience#sign_in_methods).

  • APPLE Sign in with Apple.
  • FACEBOOK Facebook Login.
  • GOOGLE Sign in with Google.
  • REVIEW_CODE The App Review code, which also needs App Review on.

SongRequestKind

Section titled “SongRequestKind”

Enum

What a request from the chat asks for.

  • KARAOKE A karaoke signup: a song the requester wants to sing.
  • SONG A song for the host or DJ to play.

SongRequestState

Section titled “SongRequestState”

Enum

Where a request is in its queue.

  • DONE Played or sung.
  • QUEUED Waiting its turn.
  • SKIPPED The host passed on it.
  • UP Called up: playing now, or the singer is on.
  • WITHDRAWN The requester took it back.

TipProvider

Section titled “TipProvider”

Enum

A way to tip a performer (a Tipping provider).

  • CASHAPP A link to their Cash App $cashtag.
  • IN_APP Paid in the app through their own Stripe or Square account: startTip, then payTip (Square) or confirmTip (Stripe).
  • PAYPAL A link to their PayPal.Me page.
  • VENMO A link to their Venmo.

TipStatus

Section titled “TipStatus”

Enum

Where an in-app tip stands.

  • CANCELED The payment was abandoned.
  • DISPUTED The fan disputed the charge with their bank.
  • FAILED The payment was declined.
  • PAID Paid to the performer.
  • PENDING Paying in the app has started but not finished.
  • REFUNDED The money went back to the fan.
